title: Billing and Coding: Micro-Invasive Glaucoma Surgery (MIGS)

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT ® codes in their CPT ® book. The CPT ® codes in Group 1 are considered medically necessary when the Indications of Coverage are met. The 90-day global periods apply. Due to the laterality of eye procedures, modifiers RT, LT or 50 should be used to indicate the eye(s) being treated. See Cataract Surgery L34413 LCD and related Billing and Coding: Cataract Surgery A56613 Article for additional coverage indications and diagnoses.
codes.2: The CPT ® codes in Group 2: Codes are considered medically necessary when the Indications of Coverage are met. The 90-day global periods apply. Do not report 0671T in conjunction with 66989 or 66991.
codes.3: The following CPT ® codes are considered not medically reasonable and necessary (non-covered).

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted.
covered.2: Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT ® code 0449T (XEN ® ) and 0671T:

noncovered.1: Any ICD-10-CM code not listed under ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity Group 1 section.
